title: Chute-fed hood shooter 1.0, preliminary design
scope: Whole-robot blockout, parked at the end of the park-lower case: back on the carpet after the low-rung hang, with the intake stowed. Field parts and FUEL are hidden. It is not detailed CAD.
alt: Rendered three-quarter still of the Chute-fed hood shooter blockout: a swerve chassis with blue bumpers carrying the tall hopper walls, the chute intake stowed between two climber tubes and the hooded flywheel at the rear.
